cues: Place the technologies on a line.
Augmented reality adds computer objects to your real view, like Pokémon Go.
Mixed reality anchors virtual objects to real ones.
Virtual reality replaces the world altogether.
VR itself is non immersive on an ordinary screen, semi immersive on a big projection, or fully immersive in a tracked headset.
